run_f_gold: run f_gold to check if two arrays can be permuted so every pair sum is at least k
test_f_gold: test f_gold with two arrays, a count n, and threshold k to verify pair sums
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to avoid mutating input arrays by using sorted copies instead of in-place sort
review_f_gold: review f_gold which sorts one array descending and the other ascending to validate pair sums against k
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that returns True if all n paired sums from two permuted arrays are greater than or equal to k
